contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return the remainder of abs(seed) divided by bound, producing an integer from zero through bound - 1. This maps an existing deterministic seed to a bucket; it does not advance the seed or claim an unbiased random sample.
contract.domain: Seed is a signed 32-bit integer. Bound is an integer between 1 and 1000.

inputRoles.bound: exclusive upper limit of bucket range

contract.outputRole: bucket index without advancing the state
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
